result.notes: Otter.ai has a REST public API (bearer-token auth, ~2 API keys/user limit, 10 req/s for Enterprise) and a separately-announced official remote MCP server (OAuth2, granular per-meeting permissions) for AI clients like Claude/ChatGPT. Both the REST API and the MCP server are gated to Enterprise-tier workspaces; Enterprise pricing is not published and requires contacting an Otter account manager/sales to enable access — no self-serve free or trial path found. help.otter.ai pages returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch, so quotes were sourced via search-engine snippets of those same pages rather than a direct WebFetch render; treat exact wording with modest caution though the substance (Enterprise-gated, bearer token, OAuth2 MCP) is corroborated across multiple independent sources (Otter's own blog, help center snippets, third-party pricing trackers).
result.one_liner: Otter.ai is an AI meeting assistant (transcription, summaries, action items) that exposes a bearer-token REST API and an official OAuth2 remote MCP server, both restricted to Enterprise-tier workspaces.
